proposals.evidence: DEDR 4666(b), distinct from earth/soil in (a), explicitly lists Tamil and Malayalam maṇal, Kannada maṇal/maḷal/maral, Kodagu maṇa and Parji/Gadaba man sand. Only this sand branch is selected; the Toda compound er-moḷṇ and earth responses under the sand prompt are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: Propose ordered head + hair for Ollari talcenṭi: DEDR3103 explicitly gives Ollari tal head, while DEDR2002 gives Gadaba kendī/kendiṭ hair in S./S.3 varieties. The same survey also has simple cendi hair. The second component’s initial palatal and final stop differences are retained and the cross-variety comparison is explicit; the whole compound is not quoted from DEDR.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 5160 directly groups the first-person singular forms in these languages. The source cognacy annotation explicitly identifies this article; full-article checking confirms the same pronoun family. Survey aēn and hēnu retain their differences from dictionary Kurukh ēn and Malto én; these are comparative proposals, not spelling corrections. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
